title: The Paley graph on 17 vertices has no independent set of size four
statement: Let $G$ be the Paley graph of order $17$: its vertices are the elements of the field $\bbz/17\bbz$, and two vertices are joined by an edge exactly when their difference is a nonzero quadratic residue modulo $17$ (that is, one of $1, 2, 4, 8, 9, 13, 15, 16$). Then $G$ contains no independent set of size $4$; equivalently, among any four vertices of $G$ some two are adjacent.
hypotheses_covered: G is the Paley graph of order 17
replaced:
\emph{The Paley graph of order 17
contains no independent set of four vertices.}
